visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, blonde-highlighted hair, wearing a white lace-patterned top and a white camisole, stands in an indoor room with a decorative geometric wall pattern. She smiles warmly at the camera, gesturing with her right hand while speaking directly to the viewer. (2) The scene shifts to a top-down close-up of a scalp where a person is applying a clear liquid from a white bottle. The camera focuses on the hair roots and the applicator's movement across the skin in a brightly lit indoor environment. (3) A montage follows, showing the woman washing her hair with thick white foam, followed by close-ups of two KARUI product bottles—one green and one blue—held together. The background is a clean, white-tiled bathroom. (4) The video transitions to macro shots of a scalp through a specialized digital lens, showing individual hair follicles and skin texture. Split-screen comparisons display 'before' and 'after' images of hair density and graying hair, with yellow variety-style text overlays. (5) The woman reappears in a brightly lit studio or closet area with shelves of luxury handbags in the background. She holds up blue and gold KARUI spray bottles, pointing to the product features while promotional graphics and pricing details appear on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy, friendly female voiceover narrating at a fast pace. The background music is an upbeat electronic pop track with a bright synth melody and a steady percussive beat. The vocal is crisp and professionally mixed. (2) A sharp 'pop' sound effect occurs as text overlays appear visually. The narration continues with high enthusiasm, discussing salon costs. The BGM remains consistent in volume, providing a energetic foundation without masking the speech. (3) A subtle 'shhh' spray sound is heard momentarily during the product application scene. The female vocal shifts slightly in pitch to emphasize product benefits. The BGM's synth melody becomes more prominent during a brief transition without speech. (4) A soft digital 'ding' sound accompanies the appearance of discount graphics. The speaker's arousal remains high as she lists promotional details. The BGM maintains its 124 BPM tempo through to the end, where it fades out quickly with the last word.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Problem Identification -> Solution Presentation -> Visual Proof -> Promotional CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a persuasive advertisement for KARUI hair care products. It starts by hooks the audience with a 'saving money' angle, identifies common scalp issues like hair loss and aging, demonstrates the ease of at-home care, provides clinical-looking macro evidence of improvement, and concludes with an aggressive promotional offer for a group buy.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct product demonstration, verbal recommendation of the brand, and specific group buy pricing graphics with discount codes.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality social media marketing video using 'before/after' visual proof and influencer credibility to drive conversion for a hair care brand.
